parsed.rationale_overall: System B more deeply integrates specific profile attributes (variable consulting income, $4M wealth target, $13K monthly expenses, legacy goal, moderate debt) into each rationale and provides more concrete dollar-amount actions and rebalancing rules. System A is cleaner and arguably better grounded (B includes some unverifiable specifics like 30-40% energy volatility and tax-savings figures), but B's superior personalization and actionability outweigh this.
